department: Chemical Process Engineering (Chemical Engineering Department, EEBE)

deadline.value: Applications are accepted throughout the academic year under UPC's general rule; the programme page sets no separate date.
deadline.quote: As a general rule, you can apply for a doctoral programme throughout the academic year.

supervisor.value: The academic committee admits applicants first and then matches them with tutors and supervisors.
supervisor.quote: the academic committee channels the applications accepted so that tutors and thesis supervisors can be assigned

funding.value: UPC predoctoral grants are awarded through annual general calls; the programme pages do not say how many students are funded.
funding.quote: General calls of predoctoral grants, financed by state and autonomous public bodies, the UPC, and private foundations.

entry_route.value: Applicants must have completed a master's degree in chemical engineering or a related field.
entry_route.quote: who have completed a master's degree in Chemical Engineering or one that is related to the scientific field of the programme

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: The department's admission pages (eebe.upc.edu, Catalan) returned 404; the programme overview on doctorat.upc.edu was used. English skills are one of the selection criteria (15%), not a waiver rule.
name: Chemical Process Engineering
